license_required.quote: any person practicing or offering to practice nursing or using the title registered professional nurse, as defined in this article, within the State of Georgia, shall be licensed as provided in this article

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Georgia Board of Nursing created in Code Section 43-26-4

name.quote: The Georgia Board of Nursing existing immediately prior to July 1, 2014, is continued in existence

type.quote: The Georgia Board of Nursing existing immediately prior to July 1, 2014, is continued in existence and shall be constituted as provided in this Code section.

umbrella_agency.value: Professional Licensing Boards Division, Office of the Secretary of State
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the office of the Secretary of State the professional licensing boards division

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Is in good physical and mental health

degree_required.value: graduated from an approved nursing education program
degree_required.quote: Have graduated from an approved nursing education program, as defined in Code Section 43-26-3

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Colleges of the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools; regional accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: A postsecondary institution of higher education that is accredited by a regional accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education

degree_level.quote: Have graduated from an approved nursing education program, as defined in Code Section 43-26-3

school_approval_basis.quote: "Approved nursing education program" located in this state means a nursing education program approved by the board as meeting criteria established by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Have graduated from an approved nursing education program, as defined in Code Section 43-26-3

required.quote: Pass a board recognized licensing examination; provided, however, that such examination may not be taken prior to graduation from the approved nursing education program

experience_source.quote: Pass a board recognized licensing examination; provided, however, that such examination may not be taken prior to graduation from the approved nursing education program

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Board recognized licensing examination required for RN licensure; specific exam name referenced in compact provisions as NCLEX-RN
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN® or NCLEX-PN® Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Board recognized licensing examination required for LPN licensure
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN® or NCLEX-PN® Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this article shall be renewed biennially according to schedules and fees approved by the board.

required.quote: Beginning with the 2016 license renewal cycle, an applicant for license renewal as a registered professional nurse under this article shall meet one of the following continuing competency requirements during the previous licensure period

hours_per_period.quote: Completion of 30 continuing education hours by a board approved provider

period_years.quote: Licenses issued under this article shall be renewed biennially according to schedules and fees approved by the board.

available.quote: An applicant for licensure by endorsement shall: Submit a completed written application and fee; Have passed a board recognized licensing examination following graduation from an approved nursing education program; Submit verification of initial and current licensure in any other licensing jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed a board recognized exam, submit verification of initial and current licensure in another jurisdiction, meet continuing competency requirements, and pass a fingerprint/criminal background check.
requirements.quote: Submit verification of initial and current licensure in any other licensing jurisdiction administering a board recognized licensing examination

exists.quote: The Georgia Board of Nursing existing immediately prior to July 1, 2014, is continued in existence and shall be constituted as provided in this Code section.

national_certification.value: National certifying body recognized by the board
national_certification.quote: Be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the board in an advanced practice registered nursing program in a role and population focus appropriate for educational preparation

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be a misdemeanor for any person, including any corporation, association, or individual, to: Practice nursing as a registered professional nurse or advanced practice registered nurse without a valid, current license

credential_type.quote: "License" means a current document, issued by the board, permitting a person to practice nursing as a registered professional nurse or a licensed undergraduate nurse.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be a misdemeanor for any person, including any corporation, association, or individual, to: Practice nursing as a registered professional nurse or advanced practice registered nurse without a valid, current license

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume such titles or use such abbreviations or any other words, letters, signs, or symbols to indicate that such person is a registered professional nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse in Georgia.

scope_protection.quote: Practice nursing as a registered professional nurse or advanced practice registered nurse without a valid, current license, except as otherwise permitted under Code Section 43-26-12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony, crime involving moral turpitude, or crime violating laws relating to controlled substances or dangerous drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony, crime involving moral turpitude, or crime violating a federal or state law relating to controlled substances or dangerous drugs in the courts of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displayed an inability to practice nursing as a registered professional nurse with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, alcohol, drugs, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice nursing as a registered professional nurse or licensed undergraduate nurse with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, including improper charting of medication and departure from minimal standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which conduct or practice need not have resulted in actual injury to any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate a law or lawfully promulgated rule or regulation relating to the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate a law or any lawfully promulgated rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the board, the United States, or any other lawful authority, without regard to whether the violation is criminally punishable, which statute, law, or rule or regulation relates to or in part regulates the practice of nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a lawful order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a lawful order of the board previously entered by the board in a disciplinary hearing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license to practice nursing revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority, or had other disciplinary action taken
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had a license to practice nursing revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority, had other disciplinary action taken by any lawful licensing authority, or was denied a license by any lawful licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in practice or on documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a business or profession licensed under this title or on any document connected therewith

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, or encouraging any unlicensed person to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by a professional licensing board to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state; any such adjudication shall automatically suspend the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with an order for child support as defined by Code Section 19-11-9.3

definition_quote.value: "Practice nursing" or "practice of nursing" means to perform for compensation or the performance for compensation of any act in the care and counsel of the ill, injured, or infirm, and in the promotion and maintenance of health with individuals, groups, or both throughout the life span.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice nursing" or "practice of nursing" means to perform for compensation or the performance for compensation of any act in the care and counsel of the ill, injured, or infirm, and in the promotion and maintenance of health with individuals, groups, or both throughout the life span.

methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the health status of individuals, groups, or both throughout the life span; Establishing a nursing diagnosis; Establishing nursing goals to meet identified health care needs; Planning, implementing, and evaluating nursing care; Providing for safe and effective nursing care rendered directly or indirectly; Managing and supervising the practice of nursing; Collaborating with other members of the health care team in the management of care; Teaching the theory and practice of nursing; Administering, ordering, and dispensing medications, diagnostic studies, and medical treatments authorized by protocol

drug_authority.value: RNs may administer, order, and dispense medications, diagnostic studies, and medical treatments authorized by protocol, when such acts are authorized by other general laws and in conformity with those laws; and may administer medications and treatments as prescribed by a physician, dentist, or podiatrist. APRNs have additional prescriptive authority under nurse protocol agreements.
drug_authority.quote: Administering, ordering, and dispensing medications, diagnostic studies, and medical treatments authorized by protocol, when such acts are authorized by other general laws and such acts are in conformity with those laws

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "The practice of licensed practical nursing" means the provision of care for compensation, under the supervision of a physician practicing medicine, a dentist practicing dentistry, a podiatrist practicing podiatry, or a registered nurse practicing nursing in accordance with applicable provisions of law.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: On and after September 1, 2025, any applicant who meets the requirements of this Code section shall be eligible for licensure as an advanced practice registered nurse.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: The following incidents shall be reported to the board in the event any person is: Practicing nursing as a registered professional nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, or a licensed practical nurse, without a valid, current license

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by the State of Georgia with any and all other states legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered professional nurse or a licensed practical nurse issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.
